activity.notes: Rijkuo-Maja (Rika Maja, 1661–1757) was a historically attested Sámi noaidi and wealthy reindeer owner from Mausjaur in the Arvidsjaur forest-Sámi area. Documentary tax records place her at Mausjaur in 1730 and 1741; ATLAS uses that bounded documentary interval as representative activity rather than inventing a full leadership term. The Civilization mod's 'Ume Sámi ruler' framing is normalized: sources describe her as an influential noaidi and community figure, not a formal sovereign. Mausjaur lies in the southeastern Ume Sámi dialect area, close to the Ume–Pite Sámi boundary.

sources.title: Bo Lundmark, 'Rijkuo-Maja and Silbo-Gåmmoe — towards the question of female shamanism in the Saami area'
sources.citation_text: Lundmark's 1987 study treats Rijkuo-Maja as a historically remembered female noaidi among the Forest Sámi of Arvidsjaur and cites documentary records from Mausjaur in 1730 and 1741.

sources.title: LIBRIS — Arvidsjaur: några bilder från förr och nu
sources.citation_text: The Swedish national library catalogue records the 1920 historical work on Arvidsjaur and indexes Rika-Maja (1661–1757) as a named historical person.
